full_content:
The Open Stage Jam is where you get to step in and play, and try your hand at doing some improv on stage!
We’ll set up simple scenes and scenarios, guide you, and keep things moving so you’re never left figuring it out on your own. You can jump in for a scene or two, try something new, and step back whenever you like.
It’s a space that’s designed to be easy to enter, and built for taking small risks. You might come in just to watch, but we’re hoping you’ll leave having played.

title: Musical Improv: An Introduction | Workshop by Improv Lore
author: amehra4u
excerpt:
If you’ve ever thought, “I’m not musical enough for musical improv,” this workshop is for you. 
Musical improv isn’t about having a perfect singing voice; it’s about listening, storytelling, pattern recognition, and …
full_content:
If you’ve ever thought, “I’m not musical enough for musical improv,” this workshop is for you.
Musical improv isn’t about having a perfect singing voice; it’s about listening, storytelling, pattern recognition, and play. In this workshop, we’ll explore some simple musical concepts, experiment with rhyme and rhythm, learn a few useful song structures, and practise turning scenes into songs without overthinking them.
We’ll play musical games, build choruses and verses, and explore a few classic musical improv formats like the Irish Drinking Song, and the Hoedown along the way.
No musical experience required. Just bring your curiosity, your willingness to sing badly before you sing brilliantly, and your sense of play.

title: Improv 101: How Not to Panic on Stage | Workshop by Improv Lore
author: amehra4u
excerpt:
Most people think improvisers are fearless; the truth is they’ve just learnt what to do when they don’t know what to do. 
This beginner-friendly introduction to improv is designed for anyone who’s ever worried about …
full_content:
Most people think improvisers are fearless; the truth is they’ve just learnt what to do when they don’t know what to do.
This beginner-friendly introduction to improv is designed for anyone who’s ever worried about saying the wrong thing, running out of ideas, or freezing up in front of others. Through fun games, simple exercises, and guided scene work, you’ll learn how to trust your instincts, embrace uncertainty, and stay present when things don’t go according to plan.
Through the course, we’ll explore some core principles of improvisation, collaborative storytelling, and spontaneous creativity in a supportive, low-stake environment.
No acting or stage experience required. You don’t need to be funny, quick-witted, or confident. You just need a willingness to step on stage and discover that you can handle more than you think.
